quests.title: Freedom Fighter Saga
quests.description: Join the Indian independence movement and learn about our freedom fighters!

story.introduction: Travel back to the time of India's freedom struggle. Meet the heroes who fought for our independence!

steps.title: The Great Revolt of 1857
steps.narrative: Witness the first major uprising against British rule. Understand its causes and impact.

problem.question: What was the immediate cause of the Revolt of 1857?
problem.explanation: The immediate cause was the introduction of Enfield rifles with cartridges greased with cow and pig fat, which offended both Hindu and Muslim soldiers.
